method: Four-connected components of published native SMOD class 30, 23 and 22, labelled separately after COD cell-centre masking, before selecting components intersecting study-region cell centres. No arbitrary hub radius. Population sum of aligned native GHS-POP cells, including entire country-masked component.
limits: Derived morphological classified-cell components; not official UCDB identifiers or functional urban areas
No commuter or institutional boundaries inferred
Country cell-centre masking and four-connectivity explicit; class22 and23 kept separate, not merged into a combined agglomeration
Class30 producer smoothing already encoded; no new smoothing applied
2025 population projections are modelled estimates, not validation observations
Rural hub points remain unmatched; no nearest-cluster forced assignment
